dispositions.reason: ownEvents is a public synchronous complete-history API owned by Session itself. Replacing it requires an explicit storage-backed complete/inherited-history reader or an intentional public API retirement; an alias or hidden async fallback would not preserve its synchronous behavior.
dispositions.retained_until: A complete/inherited-history reader or separately authorized public API retirement is available.

dispositions.reason: SessionStore.fork is synchronous and must validate a stable live prefix, exact boundary identity, contiguous seed, and open-turn rejection before creating the child. A query or persistence read cannot replace this live-owner operation without changing fork timing and failure semantics.
dispositions.retained_until: A core-owned fork-cut capability or an explicitly authorized storage-backed fork reader proves exact sequence, inherited-prefix, and open-turn equivalence.

dispositions.reason: A12 now provides the exact constructor-owned event cut synchronously on session/created. Each invariant companion can fold baseline.events for newly created Sessions while retaining one explicit snapshot scan only for already-live Sessions present when the companion mounts. A14 will implement this without adding an async storage dependency or changing event data.
dispositions.retained_until: The existing-session bootstrap scan remains until invariant installation itself has an explicit supplied restore cut.

dispositions.reason: The identity-only Session.isCommittedEvent seam replaced the feedback eventAt lookup and its focused telemetry tests pass. The sealed inventory line is historical and must not be reimplemented.
dispositions.retained_until: None; remove this line from the active successor inventory after remeasurement.

dispositions.reason: On-demand capture replays a precise suffix after a per-session handoff cursor, optionally through an inclusive event boundary, and serializes each event through redaction before backend acceptance. Replacing it needs a shared reader with fixed-cut, inherited-prefix, cancellation, cursor-advance-after-emit, and fail-closed per-event semantics; session-query is not currently a dependency of this package.
dispositions.retained_until: A lower-level shared bounded reader is specified and available without a session-query/session-telemetry composition cycle or changed backend timing.

dispositions.reason: The all-prompts provider contract requires every eligible human message through the generation watermark, while titleInput intentionally stores only a bounded first/count/last aggregate. Replacing the full scan with that aggregate would change provider inputs and model-visible behavior; adding session-query would create the existing session-query-to-session-title dependency cycle.
dispositions.retained_until: A shared title-input history reader or a separately authorized provider-contract change preserves exact ordered message inputs, cancellation, and fork semantics.

dispositions.reason: The title invariant validates that each cited seq names an earlier human user/message before publication. An asynchronous storage read cannot veto the append; a future pre-commit citation index must prove the same identity and ordering locally.
dispositions.retained_until: A core-owned pre-commit message-citation capability is specified and proves exact earlier-event identity.
